verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a standalone terminal option as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments' (docs-4) and markets terminals as 'get started fast' (docs-25). Terminals can be managed from the Customer Area (docs-3) and ordered via API (docs-11), and Tap to Pay needs no extra hardware (docs-15). However, the pack never describes the actual pairing, boarding, or registration flow, and nothing backs the 'within minutes' time-to-first-payment. missing for 10: documented reader pairing/registration steps, evidence of time-to-first-payment in minutes, hands-on or independent corroboration of quick setup.
